g.text: A local workspace for accessible research metadata.
Explore the source, report issues, or contribute.
The app and skill ship together. Browse and validate research metadata here,
then use the same release’s instructions in your preferred agent environment.
Explore the ACORN Skill → Install the desktop app →
Your content stays on this device.
AI tools assisted with code, documentation and design under human direction.
The maintainer reviews and tests the work. Review generated code before use.
